tex_content.html:
Corollary
[normal Jacobi fields form an endpoint basis]

↗ cor:dc-ch5-3-8 ↗ prop:dc-ch5-3-5 ↗ prop:dc-ch5-3-6 ↗ def:dc-ch5-3-1

1. ch5:3.10Let $\gamma :[0,a]\to M$ be a geodesic in $M$, $\dim M=n$, and let $\mathcal{J}^\perp $ be the space of Jacobi fields with $J(0)=0$, $J'(0)\perp \gamma '(0)$. Let $\{ J_1,\dots ,J_{n-1}\} $ be a basis of $\mathcal{J}^\perp $. If $\gamma (t)$, $t\in (0,a]$, is not conjugate to $\gamma (0)$, then $\{ J_1(t),\dots ,J_{n-1}(t)\} $ is a basis for the orthogonal complement $\{ \gamma '(t)\} ^\perp \subset T_{\gamma (t)}M$ of $\gamma '(t)$.
Proof

\sketch By section 2, evaluation at $t$ sends $\mathcal J^\perp $ into $\gamma '(t)^\perp $. Nonconjugacy makes this endpoint map injective by section 2. Both spaces have dimension $n-1$, so it is an isomorphism and carries any basis of $\mathcal J^\perp $ to the displayed basis.

□
